settings.heading: Jewelry care guide to enjoy your jewelry for years to come

settings.title: Beginner's scrub
settings.text: Dissolve one tablespoon of mild dish soap into a glass of warm water and let your jewelry go for a little swim. Scrub gently with a soft cloth or an old soft-bristle toothbrush before rinsing with clean water.

settings.title: Zen clean
settings.text: Add 3 drops of lemon essential oil to a half cup of witch hazel or vinegar. Let your jewelry sit for 5 minutes, and wipe with a soft polishing cloth if necessary. Rinse with clean water.
